name: Jantarnye Vospominanija Lis'ego Doma
source: Anne moves into the Fox Mansion — a peaceful seaside estate. Among her three new female neighbors, she must find the “returned one” — a deceased person who cannot rest until she takes the one she loves the most with her.
translation: 安妮搬进了福克斯大厦——一处宁静的海滨庄园。在她的三个新女邻居中，她必须找到“归来的人”——一个除非带走她最爱的人，否则无法安息的死者。
